claim_ceiling: A manufactured scalar metrology-intervention qualification reference. It is not a universal diagnostic model, tracer correction factor, raw PIV reanalysis, or physical EHD validation.

source_result.mechanism: DEHS suppresses ionization/effective conductivity and deposits as dielectric film on collector

primary_source.raw_data_boundary: raw generated datasets are available from corresponding author on reasonable request; no raw vectors or time series are included here
primary_source.source_uncertainty_boundary: numerical uncertainty bounds and allowed observer-effect thresholds in manufactured Rust tests are synthetic, not source-reported intervals

model_contract.matched_condition_key: same physical operating-condition identity across phases; intervention is the intended changed factor
model_contract.diagnostic_intervention: particle seeding, probe, tracer, illumination or another measurement process that may alter the physical state
model_contract.uncertainty_policy: conservative absolute-bound addition; no RSS unless a validated covariance receipt is added
model_contract.active_effect_interval: [max(0, abs(during - baseline) - (U_baseline + U_during)), abs(during - baseline) + (U_baseline + U_during)]
model_contract.persistence_effect_interval: same formula using after-removal state against baseline
model_contract.threshold_policy: Detected if lower effect bound > allowed tolerance; WithinTolerance if upper effect bound <= tolerance; otherwise Unresolved
model_contract.passivity_policy: cannot report overall WithinTolerance without an independently qualified baseline, matched condition identity, and post-removal measurement
